QF.id: AIFM CII Legal Documents and Negotiations_23

question.text: For how long must AIFs maintain investors' complaints data, and what is the maximum period after each quarter-end by which the data must be compiled?

answer.text: Last 1 financial year; compiled within 30 days of quarter end.
Last 5 financial years; compiled within 21 days from the end of each quarter.
Throughout the tenure of the fund; compiled within 30 days of financial year end only.
Last 3 financial years from the date of submission; compiled within 7 days from the end of each quarter.

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook (page 190) requires AIFs to maintain investor complaints data for the last three financial years from the date of submission. The data must be compiled within seven days from the end of each quarter (March, June, September, December) and disclosed to investors and SEBI. The Trap: Options A, B and C either shorten the retention window, lengthen the compilation window, or stretch retention to the full fund tenure — none of which match the workbook's 3-year / 7-day rule. Note: Stay with the workbook's plain language — three financial years from submission and seven days from quarter-end — without characterising the disclosure as a 'public' disclosure.
